metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the morning rehearsal, Nick's roll, the three changed cues, the yard after the play, and what Kemp said.

yesterday: Two cues ended alike. You changed three words: Lord Hastings, my liege, and madam. Larkham copied both rolls.
Nick knows the words. He still takes his breath late. You told him to take it before he is seen.
You kept Egeon and played him.
The yard at half past four had the stage torches just lit, and breath in the galleries.
